summary: Retest of the iteration_334 findings for Aftersales Estate Onboarding shared customer matching and the master admin CRM token loop. All 5 fixes are verified, in the API and in the UI. A new suite (test_afs_shared_customer_retest2.py) passes 8 of 8, and the earlier suites still pass 27 of 27. UI checks (Playwright, master admin, no pinned tokens): (1) Import one customer linked to an existing org, click 'Import another customer', then import an unrelated customer. The 2nd commit body has no company_id or customer_org_id, and the new customer is created as its own org; the DB confirms the first org kept 1 site only. (2) CRM token loop is fixed: from platform -> /crm -> Corporate -> Aftersales -> Onboarding there was 1 cross-login in total, 0 extra cross-logins or /crm/auth/me calls over 8s idle, and 0 HTTP 401s across both flows. /crm/auth/me for master admin returns organization_id = operator 3ece2d0c and home_organization_id = admin org d19de469, which matches /auth/me. (3) Impersonation guard still works: I swapped the main token to an impersonation token for owner@isodemo.com and kept the stale admin crm_token. The guard dropped it and minted a new one (1 cross-login) bound to iso-demo-org (home org also iso-demo-org), with no loop afterwards. (4) Picking the CRM company gave a 409 offering only the org candidate. Picking 'None of these' then sent {create_new_customer:true, company_id:<crm>}. The DB shows that CRM company now linked to the new org, still 1 CRM record with that name, and 0 sites written to the existing org. (5) Picking the org candidate on the first card sent company_id='org:<id>'. The exact-name unlinked CRM company was linked (crm_company_id = that company) and no duplicate CRM record was created. Backend-only checks: an ineligible org leaves the CRM company unlinked; if the import is already being committed (409), no link is written; a LITE org created by the iso-demo tenant's create_new_customer is stamped created_by_org_id=iso-demo-org, is not offered to the Pulse operator as a candidate, and the operator gets 404 trying to link it; an org created by the operator is not stamped as foreign. No legacy unstamped LITE orgs created by other tenants exist in the DB.

minor.issue: The picked CRM company link (_link_org) is now written after the commit claim, which is correct. But if a later step in _do_commit raises (site, equipment or contract inserts), the commit status is rolled back to its previous value while the CRM company link and any partial site/equipment writes stay. Low risk.

created_by_org_id is set by a separate update_one after provision_customer_org inserts the org. For a brief moment the org is unstamped and the operator could see it. Better to pass created_by_org_id in the lite_org_doc fields at insert time.

When a picked CRM company has no linked org, the follow-up update_one that sets linked_organization_id is unconditional (it does not filter on linked_organization_id being empty, unlike the _link_org path). Two concurrent imports could overwrite each other's link. Edge case.

issues: After 'None of these — create a new customer' following a CRM-company 409, the done text says 'Linked to the existing customer'. reused.customer is true because the CRM company was reused, but a new customer organisation was created. Consider wording like 'Linked to existing CRM customer; new organisation created'.

action_items: Optional: stamp created_by_org_id atomically at org insert
Optional: make the ~878 link update conditional on linked_organization_id being empty
Optional: clarify the done-step copy when a new org is created onto an existing CRM company
critical_code_review_comments: The reset(), doAnalyze(), doAnalyzePdf() and startSession() handlers all clear matchCands, matchChoice and prevCompany. Good.
The UnifiedAuthProvider guard compares main org to crm.home_organization_id || organization_id. Verified it no longer loops for master admin and still drops a stale token on impersonation.
/crm/auth/me now returns home_organization_id; get_crm_user sets it only for master/pulse admins, and /me falls back to organization_id otherwise.
seed_data_creation: Test data was created and then deleted by id: TEST_<tag> orgs, CRM companies and imports via the pytest fixture, and TEST_UIR5 / TEST_UIR6 via ui_afs_setup.py cleanup; a check after cleanup found 0 TEST_UIR5/6 orgs, CRM companies, sites, equipment or contracts left. Side effect: one master-admin impersonation audit event for owner@isodemo.com, created to test the guard (impersonation tokens expire after 2h).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixes from iteration_334 are verified. The master admin CRM loop is fixed, so there is no need to pin a CRM token in Playwright any more. UI path: /login -> /crm -> click 'Corporate' -> crm-nav-aftersales -> afs-tab-onboarding. Fixtures: python tests/ui_afs_setup.py setup|verify|cleanup <TAG> (export MONGO_URL and DB_NAME). Impersonation test: POST /api/master-admin/impersonate/iso-owner with the admin main token, set localStorage.token to the result, reload /crm, and check that crm_token is re-minted for iso-demo-org.
